PUNJAB STATE POWER CORPORATION LIMITED (PSPCL)
2ND AND LAST CHANCE FOR THE CANDIDATES CALLED FOR DOCUMENT CHECKING ON 27.02.25 FOR THE POST
OF CLERK AGAINST CRA 298/21
FOLLOWING CANDIDATES ARE ADVISED TO REPORT FOR DOCUMENT CHECKING BEFORE DOCUMENT CHECKING
COMMITTEE AT AS PER VENUE, DATE AND TIME MENTIONED BELOW
VENUE: TTI COMPLEX, SHAKTI VIHAR NEAR PHATAK NO. 23 ,PSPCL, Patiala, Punjab.
REPORTING DATE: .06.03.25, REPORTING TIME: 09.30 A.M.
NOTE:
1) Mere calling of any candidate for document checking doesn't entitle him/her for selection/appointment to the said post.
2) Punjab Domicile certificate and reserve category certificate is mandatory for all the candidates belonging to reserved
3) No TA/DA will be paid for the journeys performed for the document checking/counseling etc.
4) No other person on behalf of candidate can appear on document checking.
5) Tentatively, candidates three times are being called for document checking.
